compiled_state.title: As a maintainer, I want a verified spike proving extended thinking + vision works on Sonnet 4.6
compiled_state.author: Test

comments.body:
## Description

**What**: Validate that the Anthropic Claude SDK supports extended thinking (budget_tokens) and image input (base64 PNG) in a single API call on claude-sonnet-4-6.

**Why**: The feasibility reviewer flagged this combination as unverified. Building the visual-evaluator agent on an unconfirmed API pattern wastes downstream implementation effort.

**Scope**:
- IN: Single API call combining extended_thinking + vision (base64 image), with structured JSON output
- IN: Validation that 1280x800 and 1440x900 screenshots are under the 3.0 MP cap
- IN: Committed findings artifact (docs/findings/visual-evaluator-spike.md + config YAML with exact params)
- OUT: Full agent implementation (draft-1), Playwright screenshot capture (draft-2)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, docs/findings/visual-evaluator-spike.md exists, recording verbatim API response, model ID, and all inference parameters used
  <- Satisfies: sc-1  (sc-1: 'agent runs at temperature=0 and emits schema-conforming JSON')
- When this story is complete, a committed config YAML at plugins/dso/config/visual-evaluator-params.yaml records the exact model id, temperature, thinking_budget, max_tokens, and image_resolution (1280x800); draft-1 imports this file rather than re-deciding parameters
  <- Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, spike confirms both 1280x800 and 1440x900 resolutions produce parseable structured output under the 3.0 MP cap
  <- Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
